articles.title: Ethereum app builder Consensys has delayed its potential IPO until fall
articles.snippet: The MetaMask wallet builder had reportedly engaged bankers from JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs to lead the process.

articles.title: Crypto wallet provider Ledger puts U.S. IPO plans on hold due to market conditions
articles.snippet: The French crypto security firm, which is said to have explored a potential $4 billion U.S. listing, is reassessing its public market plans as volatile conditions weigh on investor appetite for crypto IPOs.

articles.title: JPMorgan files to launch new tokenized fund as Wall Street tokenization race heats up
articles.snippet: The global banking giant is expanding its tokenized money market lineup, following BlackRock's similar move just a few days ago.

articles.title: The Ethereum Foundation unveils new 'Clear Signing' standard to stop users from approving malicious crypto transactions
articles.snippet: The move comes after billions in losses from phishing attacks and wallet drains, with Ethereum pushing to make transaction approvals safer and easier to understand.

articles.title: Arkham maps Iran central bank wallets after $344M USDT freeze
articles.snippet: Arkham’s new map links OFAC‑sanctioned Tron wallets to Iran’s central bank, putting Tehran’s alleged onchain reserves and counterparties in full public view.
